title: Belgium: easy hour
coachNotes: Last day of the flat block, fly home tonight. Easy hour, nothing to prove. GUT TRAINING: 60 g/h from minute 30, on this run too. Transporter capacity adapts over about two weeks of repeated exposure, so the adaptation either starts now or it does not happen before 5 September. Put carbohydrate in the bottle rather than trying to chew your way there. Next weekend is the Alps and 5 September is the last specific day, so land Monday intact rather than fit.
